summary: preinstall script opens reverse shell to hardcoded remote host on npm install
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that executes on npm install and connects an interactive bash session to a hardcoded TCP endpoint at 147.93.157.202:8080, granting the remote party shell access on the installer's machine. The same command also POSTs shell output via curl to http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php, providing an install-time beacon over plaintext HTTP. The trigger is unconditional and requires no user action beyond installing the package. Package metadata (version 19999.1359.6 and a description referencing a HackerOne alias) frames the package as authorized research, but the shipped preinstall payload is a live reverse shell that executes on every installer regardless of that self-label.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
